**THE PTOLEMY FIELD OF 3-MANIFOLD-REPRESENTATIONS**

*STAVROS GAROUFALIDIS, MATTHIAS GOERNER, AND CHRISTIAN K. ZICKERT*

21 pp, 26 sections.

**Abstract.** The Ptolemy coordinates for boundary-unipotent SL(n, C)-representations of a 3-manifold group were introduced in [7] inspired by the A-coordinates on higher Teichm¨uller space due to Fock and Goncharov. In this paper, we deﬁne the Ptolemy ﬁeld of a (generic) PSL(2, C)-representation and prove that it coincides with the trace ﬁeld of the represen- tation. This gives an eﬃcient algorithm to compute the trace ﬁeld of a cusped hyperbolic manifold.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 1.1 The Ptolemy coordinates; 1.2 Decorated SL(2,C)-representations; 1.3 Obstruction classes and PSL(2,C)-represent; 1.4 Our results; 2 Notation; 2.1 Triangulations; 2.2 Miscellaneous; 3 The Ptolemy varieties; 3.1 The SL(2,C)-Ptolemy variety; 3.2 Obstruction classes; 4 The diagonal action; 4.1 The reduced Ptolemy varieties; 4.2 Shapes and gluing equations; 5 The Ptolemy field and the trace field; 5.1 Explicit description of the Ptolemy field; 5.2 The setup of the proof
